title: V2 attempt 02 head fit diagnostic
status: read-only diagnostic; the native candidate remains held and is not recommended for integration

browToExistingCover.method: For each brow vertex, nearest Euclidean distance to a world-space BVH union of Rounded swept crown lamina 0-3 and Swept temporal lamina -1/1 0 0.

analyticSectionDomain.method: Evaluate the section-domain q=(y-cy)/ry used by the study's cranial_width profile; |q|>1 has no supported elliptical cross-section and was clamped by the generator.
analyticSectionDomain.interpretation: The 28 mm median offset applies only to vertices within the analytic section domain. The larger cover-distance tail and unsupported forward stations explain the proud, horn-like reading; they are not a validated clearance measurement against an artist-approved shell surface.

cheekToOpticProjectedKeepout.method: Approximate 2D outer-bearing ellipse from its world Y/Z bounds, centered at y=-0.368269,z=1.782820 with radii 0.058365m and 0.057098m; count mesh vertices inside it and in front of the lens X plane.
cheekToOpticProjectedKeepout.interpretation: This is a projected vertex keepout diagnostic, not exact triangle-triangle collision proof. It confirms the cheek band's lower arc occupies the optic's visible footprint and matches the rendered masking.

observed: The new cheek band crosses the lower optic and hides part of its visible opening.
The brow reads as two raised rails/horns instead of a fitted sweeping plate.
The existing bill retains a smooth hooked surface; this attempt changes only the root stations through t<0.34, leaving the broad middle plane unresolved.

boundedCorrectionProposal: Rebuild the brow against the neighboring cranial-cover surfaces or a ray-validated analytic shell. Keep the outer plate skin within roughly 3-6 mm of that surface, taper endpoints into supported cover overlap, and avoid extrapolated section stations. Keep a physical plate thickness of that same small order; do not lift the whole band 33 mm.

Route the cheek arc outside the bearing/lens projected footprint and verify face-level clearance; keep the entire active lens and bearing opening visible. The ellipse above is an approximate screening envelope only.

For a later separately reviewed proposal, consider broadening/flattening the upper-bill middle region approximately t=0.34-0.82 on the existing blade mesh while preserving the dorsal outer contour and the final contact/apex zone (e.g. t>=0.88) exactly. That needs a new explicit allowlist and a separate native candidate; it was not changed here.
limits: No jaw-opening or other authored-motion collision checks were run for this proposal.
The projected optic ellipse is derived from object bounds; it is not an exact surface-intersection test.
The July illustration is head-only guidance, not dimensional metrology.
No GLB, runtime integration, artistic acceptance, or owner acceptance is claimed.
